title: Pork and fennel ragu
summary: Pork and fennel ragu is a italian dinner built around lean pork mince 5% fat and wholewheat spaghetti, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Start the sauce for Pork and fennel ragu: soften the onion, then add garlic and wholewheat spaghetti. Season lean pork mince 5% fat and have the pasta water on to boil.
steps.tip: Salt the pasta water. It is the only chance to season the noodles themselves.

steps.instruction: Cook lean pork mince 5% fat in the sauce while the pasta boils until tender with a bite. Save a cup of the cooking water before you drain.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, loosening it with a splash of pasta water so it clings to fennel.
steps.tip: Taste Pork and fennel ragu before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Serve Pork and fennel ragu straight away in warm bowls.  Serve with the spaghetti, simmered in salted water until tender.
